title: 你接手一间垃圾塞满的退租房

characters.worker: 圆头手绘清洁老手，蓝灰带帽工作上衣、深灰裤、黄色手套、深色鞋；小黑椭圆眼、小贴耳、完整袖裤
characters.partner: 同画法搭档，暗橙带帽工作上衣、深灰裤、浅蓝手套
characters.landlord: 同画法房东，灰紫翻领便装、深灰裤、白灰裸手

scenes.living-full: Morning. Same approved rental room: dark doorframe left, folding table left foreground, blue-grey sofa middle, iron bed beneath rear-right window, peeling wall corner. Overwhelming irregular food waste heaps conceal essentially all floor and sofa seat; no walking aisle.
scenes.living-path: Morning. Same rental room and furniture placements. Uppermost waste removed only near entrance and table; one narrow aisle, most waste still high and sofa and bed still buried. A few filled sacks outside door.
scenes.bedside: Late morning. Same iron bed under rear-right window and same peeling wall. Loose waste partly cleared near bed; damp cardboard cat nests and emptied litter trays, hard matted waste under bed; only half bed emerges initially.
scenes.kitchen-full: Late morning. Same cramped kitchen, sea-green tiled wall, sink under window right, fridge at left, stove and narrow passage. Greasy meal containers everywhere, cloudy standing sink water, damp wall-side box and localized cockroaches. Never change kitchen geometry.
scenes.kitchen-cleared: Late morning. Same sea-green kitchen geometry; empty containers partly removed, greasy counter and cabinet feet exposed, narrow floor passage now opens to living room. Pest issue unresolved.
scenes.sofa-exposed: Before midday. Same blue-grey sofa at same living-room position; loose surrounding food waste largely cleared, stained fabric and scratched foam; bed and folding table stay in same places, floor contamination remains.
scenes.sofa-removed: Midday. Same living room, blue-grey sofa now removed permanently, empty rectangular footprint with compressed hair, litter and crushed tin. Bed and table unchanged, floor grimy, no large loose heaps.
scenes.floor-dirty: Afternoon. Same living room, all large loose waste removed, sofa permanently absent, broad dirty floor exposed, hardened litter and sticky residues; bed and table unchanged, local clean patches only.
scenes.floor-partial: Afternoon. Same living room. Sofa absent permanently, broad contiguous cleaned floor areas expanding, one visibly dirty unprocessed section. Old peeling wall and stained corner not repaired.
scenes.bathroom-full: Afternoon. Tiny old bathroom through narrow half-open door, white-grey tiles, floor drain in back right, dirty clothes and empty cat-litter sacks block entry, hair and sand choke drain edge, dried wastewater rings.
scenes.bathroom-partial: Afternoon. Same bathroom geometry, clutter mostly removed, cleaner can enter, unwashed tiled patch and partly exposed drain edge; no magical pristine new tiles.
scenes.clean-room: Late afternoon. Match opening rental-room geometry exactly: dark doorframe left, folding table left, iron bed below rear-right window. All loose rubbish removed, blue-grey sofa absent permanently. Floor substantially cleaned; same peeling wall corner, swollen stained floor edge and cabinet foot remain unrepaired. Not newly renovated.
scenes.outside: Late afternoon. Ordinary residential rental building entrance and paved loading space, unbranded grey work van rear open, buckets and scrapers; refuse sacks grouped at collection point away from traffic, no people in environment master.
